items.stem:
Amara has $60 to spend at a book fair.

parts.t: Write down an inequality in n to show this information.

ms:
M1 for 7n ≤ 48 or n ≤ 6.85… oe
A1
cao, an answer of 6.85… scores M1 only
sols: Total spent = 12 for entry + 7 for each of the n books.
‘Cannot spend more than $60’ means the total is at most 60.
n must be a whole number of books, so the greatest value is 6 books
6.857… is rounded down, not to the nearest integer
Check: 6 books cost 7 × 6 + 12 = $54 ✓, but 7 books cost $61 ✗
